meta.credit: Wyscout event data via Pappalardo, L., Cintia, P., Rossi, A. et al. A public data set of spatio-temporal match events in soccer competitions. Sci Data 6, 236 (2019). https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-019-0247-7 - data: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.c.4415000.v5 - licensed CC BY 4.0. Reduced to aggregate patterns by Knowitball (changes made).
meta.tiers: league teams split by points per game inside their own league season: top = best 30%, mid = next 40%, bottom = last 30%; intl = World Cup 2018 and Euro 2016 teams

grid.frame: x 0..100 own goal -> attacked goal; y 0..100 attacker's left -> right touchline; metres = x*1.05, y*0.68

what: For a team in possession, per COARSE zone (30): what the next on-ball action is (pass_ok, pass_lost, carry, shot, end_* = possession ended there) as shares, pass types, pass length; pass_to / carry_to = row-normalised 30x30 destination matrices (row = from zone). A carry is a Wyscout 'acceleration' or a gap of more than 5 m between a reception and the receiver's next action.
